implementation_scope: Additive temperature-coefficient receiver; immutable original H/He/D physical owner remains baseline.
interpolation: Uniform lnT coefficient-space harmonic PCHIP evaluated as nonnegative Bernstein sum
maximum_advertised_scope: sampled coefficient error below1e-4; actual gas history validation reported separately by integration unit

wide.application: Safe f64x4 coefficients; 15channels+1padding; no unsafe block, no fast math/FMA.

sha2.application: Compiled immutable source and serialized-table integrity digest.

out_of_domain_policy: Call immutable direct owner and preserve its rejection; no clamp or extrapolation.
direct_fallback_policy: Endpoints, branch/floor-mask transition cells expanded by two neighbor cells; nonfinite/negative/subnormal controls also block interpolation.
